task.description: Implement EXP-601 per validated design: central tier-to-quota enforcement in kernel middleware with single configuration surface. Include quota dimensions: script CPU/memory limits, entity-storage quota, file quota, concurrent sandbox quota, and agent retry budget. Enforce quota checks centrally and return typed quota-exceeded errors. Ensure code paths align with src/api/middleware and src/config integration points. Add/adjust migrations and tests as required. Validate with zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, and error-set check. Commit and push implementation on feature/WF02-exp601-tier-quota-20260614.
acceptance_criteria: Central middleware rejects quota exceed attempts
Single config surface defines all tier-to-quota limits

result.summary: Implemented EXP-601 central tier-to-quota enforcement via a new quota middleware and single quota-policy config surface. Added typed quota profile resolution, per-dimension usage evaluation, centralized request rejection path (429) for exceeded quotas, and integrated enforcement in the main API middleware chain.
